ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 32
Logline (background for you only): Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E32.B000 [00:00.00-00:03.00] CAMERA: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
E32.B001 [00:00.00-00:02.80] SFX: Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
E32.B002 [00:03.00-00:04.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.
E32.B003 [00:03.80-00:05.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Mocking, Savoring): There it is.
E32.B004 [00:04.50-00:07.50] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.
E32.B005 [00:07.50-00:09.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Whispering, Venomous): Fear.
E32.B006 [00:07.50-00:10.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.
E32.B007 [00:09.80-00:13.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Taunting): You have been so proud of that brave little face...
E32.B008 [00:10.50-00:13.50] CAMERA: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
E32.B009 [00:13.40-00:15.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Smug, Dominant): ...but now you are afraid.
E32.B010 [00:13.50-00:16.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
E32.B011 [00:16.00-00:17.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
E32.B012 [00:16.20-00:18.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Cruel, Final): Say goodbye to your mother.
E32.B013 [00:17.00-00:19.00] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
E32.B014 [00:18.80-00:20.50] ACTION: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
E32.B015 [00:19.00-00:20.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
E32.B016 [00:20.20-00:22.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Defiant, Unbroken): Burn it.
E32.B017 [00:20.50-00:23.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
E32.B018 [00:23.00-00:25.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
E32.B019 [00:23.80-00:24.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Disconcerted): What?
E32.B020 [00:25.50-00:28.50] CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
E32.B021 [00:25.80-00:28.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Firm, Resolute): Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
E32.B022 [00:28.50-00:30.80] CAMERA: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
E32.B023 [00:29.80-00:32.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Steely, Proud): You may destroy the book...
E32.B024 [00:30.80-00:33.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
E32.B025 [00:33.50-00:36.50] CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
E32.B026 [00:33.20-00:36.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant): ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.
E32.B027 [00:36.40-00:38.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
E32.B028 [00:36.40-00:39.10] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing): You think a few herbs make you better than me?
E32.B029 [00:38.80-00:41.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
E32.B030 [00:39.20-00:42.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): No. Your cruelty does that for me.
E32.B031 [00:41.00-00:43.50] CAMERA: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
E32.B032 [00:43.50-00:45.50] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
E32.B033 [00:43.40-00:45.40] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting): You still think you are better?!
E32.B034 [00:45.50-00:47.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
E32.B035 [00:45.60-00:47.40] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Serene, Grounded): I know what I am.
E32.B036 [00:47.80-00:49.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
E32.B037 [00:47.80-00:49.00] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking): A disgraced woman?
E32.B038 [00:49.00-00:52.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
E32.B039 [00:49.20-00:52.40] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Unwavering): A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
E32.B040 [00:52.50-00:54.40] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
E32.B041 [00:52.80-00:54.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged): You are lying!
E32.B042 [00:54.40-00:58.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
E32.B043 [00:54.60-00:58.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic): Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.
E32.B044 [00:58.00-01:00.80] CAMERA: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
E32.B045 [00:58.20-01:01.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing): He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.
E32.B046 [01:00.80-01:04.50] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
E32.B047 [01:01.10-01:06.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Passionate, Clear): He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.
E32.B048 [01:04.50-01:07.00] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
E32.B049 [01:07.00-01:09.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
E32.B050 [01:07.20-01:08.90] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious): Let him have Clarissa.
E32.B051 [01:09.00-01:11.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
E32.B052 [01:09.60-01:11.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Proud): He lost me.
E32.B053 [01:11.20-01:13.30] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
E32.B054 [01:11.30-01:13.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious): You were rejected!
E32.B055 [01:13.30-01:15.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
E32.B056 [01:13.40-01:17.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful): I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.
E32.B057 [01:15.50-01:17.50] CAMERA: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
E32.B058 [01:17.50-01:20.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
E32.B059 [01:17.80-01:19.40] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Disdainful): Your soldier?
E32.B060 [01:20.00-01:22.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
E32.B061 [01:20.20-01:22.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Tender, Certain): My husband.
E32.B062 [01:22.50-01:24.10] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
E32.B063 [01:22.50-01:24.00] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Bitter): He is a nobody.
E32.B064 [01:24.10-01:26.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
E32.B065 [01:24.20-01:26.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Warm, Defiant): Then I love a nobody.
E32.B066 [01:26.50-01:29.80] CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
E32.B067 [01:26.50-01:30.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Resonant, Moving): Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.
E32.B068 [01:29.80-01:32.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
E32.B069 [01:30.10-01:32.60] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp): You know nothing about my world.
E32.B070 [01:32.80-01:37.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
E32.B071 [01:33.20-01:36.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Knowing, Sober): I know exactly what your world values.
E32.B072 [01:37.00-01:39.80] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
E32.B073 [01:37.60-01:39.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate): Beauty. Money.
E32.B074 [01:39.80-01:41.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
E32.B075 [01:41.00-01:43.70] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
E32.B076 [01:41.20-01:43.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Firm): Family. A perfect name.
E32.B077 [01:43.70-01:47.00] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
E32.B078 [01:43.80-01:47.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Continuing): And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.
E32.B079 [01:47.00-01:48.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
E32.B080 [01:47.20-01:48.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged): And what is wrong with that?!
E32.B081 [01:48.80-01:49.40] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
E32.B082 [01:49.40-01:52.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
E32.B083 [01:49.50-01:52.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating): Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.
E32.B084 [01:52.50-01:56.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
E32.B085 [01:52.80-01:56.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Unrelenting): You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...
E32.B086 [01:56.00-01:56.80] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
E32.B087 [01:56.80-01:59.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
E32.B088 [01:56.90-01:59.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Piercing): ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.
E32.B089 [01:59.50-02:01.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
E32.B090 [01:59.60-02:01.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming): Silence! Silence!
E32.B091 [02:01.80-02:03.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
E32.B092 [02:01.80-02:02.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Shrieking): Why?!
E32.B093 [02:02.80-02:05.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
E32.B094 [02:03.00-02:05.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Forceful): Because I am right!
E32.B095 [02:05.00-02:08.50] CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
E32.B096 [02:05.40-02:08.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Scathing, Direct): You want everyone to believe you are powerful.
E32.B097 [02:08.50-02:11.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
E32.B098 [02:09.00-02:11.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Continuing): You want everyone to fear you.
E32.B099 [02:11.80-02:14.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
E32.B100 [02:12.00-02:14.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Mocking, Direct): But look at you.
E32.B101 [02:14.80-02:18.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
E32.B102 [02:15.00-02:18.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare): You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!
E32.B103 [02:18.50-02:20.40] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
E32.B104 [02:18.60-02:20.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Choking with Rage): You insolent—!
E32.B105 [02:20.40-02:22.40] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
E32.B106 [02:20.40-02:22.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant): You may have the title you have always wanted...
E32.B107 [02:22.40-02:26.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
E32.B108 [02:22.40-02:26.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Final, Condemning): ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.
E32.B109 [02:26.50-02:28.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
E32.B110 [02:26.60-02:28.10] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting): You think you can lecture me?!
E32.B111 [02:28.00-02:30.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
E32.B112 [02:28.00-02:30.80] ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
E32.B113 [02:28.10-02:31.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal): Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!
E32.B114 [02:30.80-02:32.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
E32.B115 [02:31.20-02:34.38] ACTION: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.
E32.B116 [02:32.00-02:34.38] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.
